verdict.rationale: Authy is an authenticator app, so support for non-standard token types is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows standard 2FA QR-code capture (Facebook, Amazon, Google, etc.) and generic TOTP generation. Nothing in the pack covers Steam Guard codes, HOTP counter-based tokens, custom periods or custom digit lengths.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
